responsibility: This subtarget header provides RTEMS-specific preprocessor builtins for m68k ELF targets, overriding the generic embedded target OS macro definition from m68kemb.h. It identifies the target as RTEMS, enables __USE_INIT_FINI__, and retains the expected mc68000-style predefined macro, making it the thin RTEMS OS adaptation layer layered on top of the embedded m68k configuration.
